6c8a7e490f835015.description: # Build With Us — WhipScribe Founding Software Engineer We're looking for a **Founding Software Engineer** to join WhipScribe and work directly with the founding team on a real product used by real customers. Instead of evaluating candidates only through resumes and interviews, we want to see **how you think, what you build, and how you ship**. ## Start Here ### 🚀 [Open the WhipScribe Buildathon & Hiring Challenge](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon) **Please read the complete challenge repository before submitting your application.** The repository contains the complete hiring challenge, available tracks, instructions, evaluation criteria, setup information, and submission process. You can choose the challenge that best demonstrates your strengths — whether that's **desktop development, web/product engineering, APIs, AI workflows, MCP integrations, UI/UX, or something you want to build from scratch.** ## What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who: * Builds without waiting for detailed instructions. * Can take an idea from **problem → solution → implementation → deployment**. * Has strong product and UI/UX judgment. * Uses AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Copilot, and coding agents effectively. * Understands, validates, and improves AI-generated work rather than blindly accepting it. * Is comfortable working across technologies and learning quickly. * Cares about what reaches the customer, not just what works locally. * Takes ownership and enjoys working in a fast-moving startup environment. ## Your First Step Before building anything, **show us what you've already built.** Share your: * GitHub * LinkedIn * Portfolio * Shipped applications * Hackathon projects * Open-source work * Projects you're proud of * Team or leadership experience Then use WhipScribe yourself and look at the product as both an engineer and a user. Find something that could be better. Then **build.** ## The Challenge The Buildathon repository contains multiple tracks, including: **Track 1 — Find What Is Wrong** Use WhipScribe on desktop and mobile, identify meaningful product/UI/UX problems, and propose improvements. **Track 2 — Build the Desktop App** Build a real desktop meeting-recording experience integrated with WhipScribe. **Track 3 — Google Drive, Bulk Upload & Search** Build a workflow for processing recordings from Google Drive and searching across their transcripts. **Track 4 — Invent a Workflow** Identify a real problem that can be solved with audio/video intelligence and build the workflow using the WhipScribe API, MCP server, or both. You can choose one or more tracks. ## Don't Optimize for Size We don't expect you to build a huge system. **One small, polished feature that actually works is better than a massive unfinished project.** We want to see: * Your product thinking * Your engineering ability * Your UI/UX judgment * Your ability to use AI effectively * Your attention to detail * Your ability to finish * Your ability to learn * Your ownership ## How to Submit Follow the instructions inside the Buildathon repository: ### 👉 [View the Full Challenge & Submit Your Work](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon) Your submission should include your project/source code, explanation of what you built, demo where applicable, and the other information requested by the selected challenge track. **Please do not submit a proposal without first reading the Buildathon repository.** ## What Happens Next We review your work based on the quality of your thinking, implementation, product sense, and ability to ship. Strong candidates may be invited to work with us on the real product before receiving the full-time offer, allowing both sides to evaluate the fit through actual work. ### The Opportunity **Role:** Founding Software Engineer **Company:** Neugence Technology — WhipScribe **Work:** Fully Remote **Compensation:** ₹6–10 LPA, negotiable based on skills and ownership **Type:** Full-time **Joining:** Immediate You'll work directly with the founding team and have ownership over real product areas from the beginning. --- ## Ready? Don't just tell us you're a builder. ### **Show us.** 🚀 **[Start the WhipScribe Buildathon →](https://github.com/neugence/whipscribe-buildathon)**

6ccd2b622f8ec236.description: We are hiring a Technical Product Manager who can also operate as our Lead Business Analyst. This is a domain-heavy product role: we need someone who genuinely understands US risk adjustment CMS-HCC and HHS-HCC models, encounter and EDGE data, chart review, and audit defence and who can convert that expertise into a product that engineers can build and customers will trust. You will sit between US payer customers, clinical and coding subject matter experts, and an AI/data engineering team. You will own problem definition, requirements, data logic, and acceptance criteria for one or more product lines, and you will be accountable for whether what we ship is correct against CMS and HHS rules not only whether it was delivered on time. This is a hands-on role. You will write specifications, interrogate data, define validation logic, and sit in UAT. You will not be managing a team of BAs on day one, though you will set the standard the rest of the organisation follows. What You Will Own Product direction Own the roadmap and backlog for an assigned product area (chart review AI, encounter/EDGE submissions, RAF analytics, or RADV audit readiness). Translate CMS and HHS regulatory change model version updates, submission deadlines, RADV protocol changes into product decisions, sequencing, and release planning. Define success measures for each feature (coder throughput, RAF accuracy, submission acceptance rates, audit defensibility) and track outcomes after release. Partner with founders, sales, and implementation on customer discovery, demos, pilots, and beta feedback loops. Requirements and domain logic Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements for risk adjustment, HCC analytics, and submission workflows. Write user stories, use cases, process flows, data mapping documents, business rules, and acceptance criteria that an engineer can build from without needing a second conversation. Specify CMS-HCC model logic (including V24 and V28), HHS-HCC logic for ACA, RAF calculation, diagnosis eligibility, and filtering rules in enough detail to be implemented and tested. Define file-level behaviour for X12 837 I/P/D, TA1, 999, 277CA, MAO-002, MAO-004, MMR, MOR, and ACA EDGE Server XML files including enrolment, medical, pharmacy, and supplemental diagnosis submissions. Specify reconciliation logic that traces rejected, dropped, or failed records back to source claims, encounters, charts, and member data. Technical partnership Work directly with data and AI engineers on data models, pipeline behaviour, and edge cases; read and write SQL to validate what the platform actually produces. Define evaluation criteria for AI outputs code suggestion precision and recall, MEAT evidence quality, hallucination controls, human-in-the-loop review steps, and audit trail requirements. Contribute to API and integration design for EHR, coding platform, and payer data exchange. Own UAT planning and regression scenarios aligned to CMS model files, business rules, and real customer data conditions. What We Are Looking For Required 612 years in US healthcare, including at least 3 years in a product management, product owner, or lead BA capacity on a healthcare data or SaaS product. Deep working knowledge of risk adjustment for Medicare Advantage and/or ACA Marketplace: CMS-HCC and/or HHS-HCC models, RAF scoring, HCC mapping, and the diagnosis-to-payment relationship. Strong command of healthcare claims data ICD-10-CM, CPT/HCPCS, claim frequency codes, place of service, dates of service, provider and rendering identifiers, and the fields that determine diagnosis eligibility. Practical experience with encounter data submission (RAPS/EDPS) or ACA EDGE server submissions, including response file handling and error resolution. Demonstrated ability to write specifications that engineering teams can build from: business rules, data mappings, state transitions, and acceptance criteria. SQL proficiency sufficient to profile data, reproduce defects, and validate calculations independently. Comfortable in a startup environment self-directed, proactive, and able to work with US stakeholders across time zones with strong written and spoken English. Strongly preferred Direct exposure to RADV or HHS-RADV audits sampling, medical record retrieval, coder validation, discrepancy handling, or extrapolation methodology. Experience shipping AI or NLP-enabled products, and defining how model output is measured, reviewed, and governed. Background as a certified coder (CPC, CRC, CCS) or clinical documentation specialist, or close working experience with coding and CDI teams. Prior work at a payer, risk adjustment vendor, or provider-side risk organisation. Familiarity with HIPAA, PHI handling, and audit trail expectations in production systems. What Success Looks Like First 90 days: fluent in our data model and product lines; owning the backlog for one product area; requirements accepted by engineering with .

We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytics skills with a product mindset. You’ll start by going deep into data — tracking KPIs, running experiments, and generating insights — and progressively take ownership of data-powered products like Analytics Agents, automated anomaly detection, and AI-augmented decision tools.

What You’ll Do

• Track key business KPIs, perform root cause analyses, and recommend corrective actions.
• Analyze customer funnels, cohorts, and conversion metrics to surface high-impact opportunities.
• Design and run A/B experiments; measure results with statistical rigour.
• Build automated reporting solutions and maintain business dashboards.
• Own the product roadmap for data-heavy tracks — write specs, define success metrics, and ship iteratively with engineering.
• Leverage LLMs and AI to automate insight generation & summarisation
• Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, and business teams to prioritise and deliver.

What We Expect

• Outcome-oriented: you own problems end-to-end, not just tasks.
• You go beyond “what” to explain “why” and “so what.”
• Builder’s instinct: you see manual workflows and think “this should be a product.”
• Clear communication across engineering, product, and leadership teams.
• You actively use AI tools to work faster and think deeper.

Must-Have

• 3+ years in data analytics is mandatory (e-commerce, consumer internet, or product-led environments preferred).
• Hands-on experience with user journey funnels, cohort analysis, and conversion metrics at scale.
• Strong SQL & Python proficiency; comfortable with large, complex datasets.
• Proven ability to turn analytical findings into acted-upon product or business recommendations
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Undergraduate degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution.

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.

In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

• 
Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.
• 
Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.
• 
Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.
• 
Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.
• 
Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.
• 
Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.
• 
Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

Required Experience

• 
At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.
• 
Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.
• 
Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.
• 
Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

• 
Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.
• 
Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.
• 
Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.
• 
Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.
• 
Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.
• 
Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.
• 
Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.
